description: List the articles of a law that were amended, added or removed since a date, by consolidated version on matsne.gov.ge, with a link to each version. Use it to see whether a rule was different when the events happened. კანონის ცვლილებები მითითებული თარიღიდან: რომელი მუხლი შეიცვალა, დაემატა ან ამოიღეს და რომელ რედაქციაში.

code.description: Code id from list_codes (e.g. civil_code, labour_code) or its Georgian name (e.g. შრომის კოდექსი).
code.title: Code

name: list_changes

article_number.description: As printed in the law, e.g. 'მუხლი 47'.
article_number.title: Article Number

version_date.description: Date matsne gives the consolidated version that carries the change.
version_date.title: Version Date

version_url.description: Official link to exactly that version.
version_url.title: Version Url

data_current_as_of.description: Date (ISO) the stored law texts were last confirmed against matsne.gov.ge. Tell the person this date.
data_current_as_of.title: Data Current As Of

freshness_warning.description: Set when that check is overdue or its date is unknown; pass the warning on with the answer.
freshness_warning.title: Freshness Warning

history_from.description: Date of the oldest stored version; nothing earlier is known.
history_from.title: History From

notice.default: ეს არის კანონის ტექსტი და წყარო, არა იურიდიული კონსულტაცია. ოფიციალური ტექსტი: matsne.gov.ge. This is law text and its source, not legal advice. The official text is on matsne.gov.ge; for important decisions consult a lawyer.
notice.title: Notice
